# OOD-PerceptionBench -- Python requirements for the PDM-Lite evaluation environment.
#
# Install on Python 3.10:
#
#   pip install -r env/requirements-pdmlite.txt
#
# This is upstream's team_code/requirements.txt from autonomousvision/carla_garage at the
# pinned commit beb3433407f42c1adced312b877a61fe04f338ba (see patches/UPSTREAM.txt), with
# exactly ONE line changed:
#
#   numpy==1.26.4  ->  numpy==1.23.5
#
# Why that line, and why that exact version:
#   * Bench2Drive's leaderboard and scenario_runner trees at the pinned commit still use the
#     numpy aliases (np.float, np.int, np.bool, np.object) that numpy 1.24 removed -- in
#     Bench2Drive/leaderboard/team_code/{birds_eye_view/chauffeurnet,privileged_route_planner,
#     transfuser_utils}.py and Bench2Drive/scenario_runner/manual_control.py, the files
#     upstream's later fix cc28a50 touches -- so numpy must stay below 1.24;
#   * scipy==1.14.1 (unchanged below) requires numpy >= 1.23.5.
# 1.23.5 is the only release that satisfies both.
#
# Why a copy and not a constraints file: upstream pins numpy EXACTLY, and pip treats an exact
# requirement plus a conflicting `-c` constraint as a conflict, not as an override.
#
# setup.sh --verify-only checks that every other line still equals upstream's file at the
# pinned commit, so this copy cannot drift silently. Change it only together with the pin.
